input_contract.label: Native vegetation conversion — hard land-use exclusion
input_contract.true: Proposed planting would replace existing indigenous natural vegetation. Exclude the site.
input_contract.false: Habitat and proposed intervention assessed. Planting would retain indigenous natural vegetation. This passes only the conversion safeguard.
input_contract.unknown: Native habitat, proposed conversion or assessment coverage unresolved. Leave opportunity unknown.
input_contract.category_handling: Broad land-cover codes cannot identify indigenous vegetation or establish conversion. Match the planting footprint and habitat history to locally appropriate evidence.
input_contract.input_requirement: Supply a site- or AOI-assessed conversion mask for the proposed planting, with habitat evidence, coverage, assessment date and intervention scope.

justification: Exclude proposed tree planting wherever it would replace existing indigenous natural vegetation. ITTO GE20 explicitly identifies native tropical grasslands, savannas and wetlands. Pete adopted the broader no-conversion rule. Restoration of degraded native forest that retains existing indigenous vegetation can pass this safeguard. Unresolved habitat or conversion status remains unknown. WorldCover supplies land-cover context only.
